result.headline: Northbridge grew more threatening after the formation tweak

paragraphs.text: After Northbridge switched to a 4-2-3-1 at 45′ they produced the only shots in this spell and completed more passes, with a clear shift toward sustained possession that reached the attacking third on several occasions; however, only one of their complete possession sequences included a shot and five stalled before entering the box, so the threat level rose but wasn't fully converted.

By contrast Southport’s completed sequences stayed short: none of their 12 complete possessions carried a successful action into the attacking third or produced a shot, and their completed passes fell in the same comparison window, suggesting momentum favoured Northbridge though the exact impact of the booking to Morgan is unclear.

limitations: Formation, off-ball movement and chance quality are not inferred from sparse events.
